import json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
import lightgbm as lgb
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
import re

# Load data
with open("./input/train/train.json", "r") as f:
    train_data = json.load(f)
with open("./input/test/test.json", "r") as f:
    test_data = json.load(f)

# Convert to DataFrame
train_df = pd.DataFrame(train_data)
test_df = pd.DataFrame(test_data)

# Combine train and test for consistent feature engineering
n_train = len(train_df)
all_df = pd.concat([train_df, test_df], axis=0, ignore_index=True)


# Extract text features
def extract_text_features(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return [0, 0, 0, 0]
    words = text.split()
    word_count = len(words)
    char_count = len(text)
    uppercase_ratio = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper()) / max(len(text), 1)
    positive_words = sum(
        1
        for w in words
        if w.lower() in ["please", "thanks", "thank", "appreciate", "kind", "help"]
    )
    return [word_count, char_count, uppercase_ratio, positive_words]


text_features = np.array(
    [extract_text_features(t) for t in all_df["request_text_edit_aware"]]
)
all_df["text_len"] = text_features[:, 1]
all_df["word_count"] = text_features[:, 0]
all_df["uppercase_ratio"] = text_features[:, 2]
all_df["pos_sentiment"] = text_features[:, 3]

# Subreddit diversity
all_df["subreddit_count"] = all_df["requester_subreddits_at_request"].apply(
    lambda x: len(x) if isinstance(x, list) else 0
)

# Time-based features
all_df["request_time_hour"] = pd.to_datetime(
    all_df["unix_timestamp_of_request"], unit="s"
).dt.hour

# Replace missing with 0
numeric_cols = [
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
    "text_len",
    "word_count",
    "uppercase_ratio",
    "pos_sentiment",
    "subreddit_count",
    "request_time_hour",
]

for col in numeric_cols:
    all_df[col] = all_df[col].fillna(0)

# TF-IDF on request text
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=200, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=3, stop_words="english"
)
all_tfidf = tfidf.fit_transform(all_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna(""))

# Split back into train and test
X_train_full = all_df.iloc[:n_train][numeric_cols].values
y_train_full = all_df.iloc[:n_train]["requester_received_pizza"].values.astype(int)
X_test = all_df.iloc[n_train:][numeric_cols].values

X_train_full_sparse = X_train_full.copy()
X_test_sparse = X_test.copy()

X_train_full_combined = hstack([csr_matrix(X_train_full), all_tfidf[:n_train]])
X_test_combined = hstack([csr_matrix(X_test), all_tfidf[n_train:]])

# First split: Train/Validation (for tuning) and Hold-Out Validation (unseen)
X_train1, X_holdout, y_train1, y_holdout = train_test_split(
    X_train_full_combined,
    y_train_full,
    test_size=0.15,
    stratify=y_train_full,
    random_state=42,
)

# Split the train1 set again for actual training (since train1 includes the tuning set, we'll do proper tuning)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train1,
    y_train1,
    test_size=0.2,
    stratify=y_train1,
    random_state=42,
)

# Hyperparameter search on X_tr/y_tr, validate on X_val/y_val
best_auc = 0.0
best_params = None

search_params = [
    {"num_leaves": 31, "learning_rate": 0.05, "feature_fraction": 0.8},
    {"num_leaves": 63, "learning_rate": 0.03, "feature_fraction": 0.7},
    {"num_leaves": 15, "learning_rate": 0.07, "feature_fraction": 0.9},
    {"num_leaves": 47, "learning_rate": 0.04, "feature_fraction": 0.85},
    {"num_leaves": 23, "learning_rate": 0.06, "feature_fraction": 0.75},
    {"num_leaves": 55, "learning_rate": 0.025, "feature_fraction": 0.9},
    {"num_leaves": 39, "learning_rate": 0.045, "feature_fraction": 0.7},
    {"num_leaves": 27, "learning_rate": 0.055, "feature_fraction": 0.8},
    {"num_leaves": 41, "learning_rate": 0.035, "feature_fraction": 0.85},
    {"num_leaves": 19, "learning_rate": 0.065, "feature_fraction": 0.65},
    {"num_leaves": 51, "learning_rate": 0.02, "feature_fraction": 0.75},
    {"num_leaves": 35, "learning_rate": 0.04, "feature_fraction": 0.9},
]

for params_set in search_params:
    train_data_lgb = lgb.Dataset(X_tr.tocsr(), label=y_tr)
    val_data_lgb = lgb.Dataset(X_val.tocsr(), label=y_val, reference=train_data_lgb)

    params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "auc",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "num_leaves": params_set["num_leaves"],
        "learning_rate": params_set["learning_rate"],
        "feature_fraction": params_set["feature_fraction"],
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 5,
        "verbose": -1,
        "seed": 42,
        "force_col_wise": True,
    }

    try:
        model = lgb.train(
            params,
            train_data_lgb,
            num_boost_round=500,
            valid_sets=[val_data_lgb],
            callbacks=[
                lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False),
                lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
            ],
        )
        val_preds = model.predict(X_val.tocsr())
        auc_score = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
        if auc_score > best_auc:
            best_auc = auc_score
            best_params = params.copy()
    except Exception:
        continue

# Retrain final model on train1 (train + first validation) with best params, NO early stopping
params_final = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": best_params["num_leaves"],
    "learning_rate": best_params["learning_rate"],
    "feature_fraction": best_params["feature_fraction"],
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "force_col_wise": True,
}

train_data_final = lgb.Dataset(X_train1.tocsr(), label=y_train1)
final_model = lgb.train(
    params_final,
    train_data_final,
    num_boost_round=500,
)

# Predict on hold-out set (unseen by model during training/tuning)
holdout_preds = final_model.predict(X_holdout.tocsr())
holdout_auc = roc_auc_score(y_holdout, holdout_preds)
print(f"{holdout_auc:.8f}")

# Predict on test set
test_preds = final_model.predict(X_test_combined.tocsr())

# Create submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": test_df["request_id"], "requester_received_pizza": test_preds}
)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
